$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFPH (AIP France, chart dated 2023-11-30): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Chelles - Le Pin

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 37, due to environmental reasons
notes: Use of the aerodrome reserved for based pilots or pilots respecting the conditions defined by DSAC Nord retrievable on website: https://salledelecture-ext. aviation-civile.gouv.fr/externe/DSAC/ programme_formation_qualification_site_LFPH.pdf AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Usable declared distances: RWY 11, 22 and 29 TODA reduced due to obstacles in the TKOF funnel.
Air navigation hazard Helipad with restricted use (Fire and rescue centre) located in the 222°/0.8 NM.
Favor the use of RWY 04/22 due to the presence of obstacles in the clearances of RWY 11/29.
Preferred QFU 037°, due to environmental reasons.
RWY must be vacated towards installations after landing whatever the RWY in use.
Follow the circuits represented on the visual landing chart, due to urban surroundings.
Landing prohibited on RWY 11.
Solo traffic patterns prohibited for student pilots during initial training.
Touch and Go prohibited.

CHELLES LE PIN Conditions d'utilisation de l'AD L'usage de l'aérodrome est réservé aux pilotes basés et respectant les conditions définies par la DSAC Nord consultables via internet : https://salledelectureext.aviation-civile.gouv.fr/externe/DSAC/ programme_formation_qualification_site_LFPH.pdf AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Distances déclarées utilisables : TODA RWY 11, 22 et 29 réduites cause obstacles dans la trouée de décollage.
Dangers à la navigation aérienne Présence d'une hélisurface à usage restreint (Centre d'incendie et de secours) située dans le 222°/0.8 NM.
Privilégier l'utilisation de la piste 04/22 en raison de la présence d'obstacles dans les dégagements de la piste 11/29.
QFU 037° préférentiel pour des raisons environnementales.
Dégager obligatoirement vers les installations après LDG quelle que soit la piste en service.
Compte tenu de l'environnement urbain, respecter les circuits représentés sur la carte atterrissage à vue.
Atterrissage interdit en piste 11.
Tours de piste solo pour élèves pilotes en formation initiale interdits.
Touch and Go interdits.
